headline: Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia Following Trump Intervention
summary: President Donald Trump intervened with Nvidia's board to assure directors that longtime chief executive Jensen Huang presented no national security risk, clearing his return to lead the chipmaker.
why: Nvidia is the primary designer of advanced artificial intelligence semiconductors, making its executive leadership and regulatory standing critical to global equity markets.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Resolving leadership questions and easing national security friction removes substantial governance overhang for Nvidia.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The return of Jensen Huang resolves executive uncertainty at Nvidia after national security concerns prompted board scrutiny.
